title: Dim cab lights when the monitor is plugged in
description: Brightness the cab Wiz lights that are on get once, when a Q24h-10 monitor is plugged into the MacBook (LaunchAgent com.jacobr.display-cab-dimmer).

settings.name: enabled
settings.label: Enabled
settings.description: Dim the cab lights when the monitor is plugged in. When off, plug-ins are still recorded but the lights are left alone.

settings.name: brightness
settings.label: Cab brightness
settings.description: Brightness applied to each cab light that is on when the monitor appears.

settings.name: settle_seconds
settings.label: Settle time
settings.description: How long the display list must stay unchanged before it is compared with the previous one.
